messages:
nina: Noticed weird behavior on the latency dashboard: p95 for /v1/chat jumped but per-endpoint breakdown is flat. Looks like a routing policy change at ~15:40 UTC. any ideas? :mag:
rahul: can you paste a tiny sample slice? unsure if this is a blended-attribution issue or a real tail.
nina: pasted snippet + console link: https://console.redwood/latency?endpoint=/v1/chat&range=2h
---
# samples (ts, route, latency_ms, attempt)
2026-04-01T15:39:58Z route=primary latency_ms=90 attempt=0
2026-04-01T15:40:05Z route=overflow latency_ms=620 attempt=0
2026-04-01T15:40:06Z route=overflow latency_ms=590 attempt=0
2026-04-01T15:40:09Z route=primary latency_ms=95 attempt=0
---
cheng: looks like a few overflow hits moved the blended p95. If our UI only shows "overall" without showing route sample_counts people will be confused.
paula: proposal: add an "attribution toggle" in the chart header with options: blended | initial | final. Default to blended for now. Also show per-route small-n warnings and sample_count inline (n=8 for overflow).
rahul: backend note: we currently ingest route_initial and route_final. Queries are expensive when splitting by both. Suggest precomputed per-route p50/p95/p99 rollups at 1m granularity. Storage should be small but avoids huge query cost.
cheng: UX: also add a tiny confidence chip next to each percentile that says: low/medium/high based on bootstrap CI width or sample_count thresholds. e.g. n<30 = low, 30-200 = medium, >200 = high. show tooltip with "95% CI" numbers.
paula: short-term hack: when a route contributes >25% of blended p95 value, show a yellow "route-contributor" badge and expand legend to show top-3 contributors with their p95s and n. long-term: rollups + confidence chips.
ops-bot: ticket LT-12009 created by paula: "add attribution toggle + percentile confidence chip + route-contributor badge". linked: infra/telemetry cost estimate.
rahul: I'll prototype the rollup ingestion change and post estimated storage delta. cheng, can you mock the confidence chip copy?
cheng: on it. thinking: "Estimate noisy: p95 CI 250-520ms (n=8)" for small-n.
paula: minor API ask: add query param `attribution` to /timeseries which accepts blended|initial|final. Backwards compat default = blended. add note to changelog.
nina: thanks, this should cut down on "why did our p95 spike" pings. marking thread resolved pending LT-12009. :white_check_mark:
